title: Rabbi Yaakov bar Avina
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Jerusalem Talmud Shevuot 6:3 mentions him. In Shemot Rabbah 3:6 he reports Rabbi Huna of Tzippori; in Esther Rabbah 3:12 he expounds before Rabbi Yitzchak. Kohelet Rabbah 1:4 lists Rabbi Berechyah, Rabbi Yaakov bar Avina and Rabbi Chiya bar Abba reporting Levi bar Sisi. Hyman states that Yaakov undoubtedly reported Rabbi Chiya bar Abba.

notes.text: Shemot Rabbah 3:6 explicitly names Huna of Tzippori. The proposed link through Chiya bar Abba is Hyman’s inference from the compressed list of reporters; the claim is not independently established by naming Huna.
